children: Magle Chemoswed Holding AB (publ) completed its debt and capital restructuring, including up to SEK 203M super senior bonds, a debt-for-equity swap with share issuance, reinstated bonds, and directed share issues.
Issues up to SEK 203M super senior bonds
Adds priority liquidity and extends runway; senior ranking de-risks near-term solvency.
Reduces indebtedness and interest burden; dilutive but strengthens balance sheet.
Cuts legacy obligations, improving leverage and credit profile.
Resets terms on remaining debt; watch covenants and maturities.
Brings in equity capital and aligns investors/board; dilutive to holders.

This is a late-stage balance sheet fix previously flagged in July, now implemented to support an operational turnaround. For a larger catalyst, investors need visibility on cash burn, covenant headroom, and tangible turnaround KPIs from CMO and biopolymers units.
